purpose: Teach: 明子/大介/康弘/ナターシャ/ミミ/目新しい/マジメ/思ひ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「明子おばさんはお花が上手」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Akiko-aunt is really skilled with flowers.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. A gentle sharing of something noticed about his world. Unhurried. The affection of an older sister passing along a small observation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと大介いとこと公園で遊んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to the park with Dad and Daisuke-cousin today.
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. Small bright voice, quick pace. The excitement of having something to report, to share with someone he trusts. Clean energy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「康弘おじいちゃんに会いに行こう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying he wants to go visit Yasuhiro-grandpa.
lines.style: Warm reflection. A thought passed along carefully, as if giving him something to hold onto. Gentle pacing. The tone of someone who notices what matters to him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「ナターシャの物語」の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I read the picture book "Natasha's Story" together.
lines.style: Open, proud tone. The words come easily—this is something he was pleased about. Natural, unforced pace. A small moment of connection he wants to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「ペットのミミちゃんは賢い」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying Mimi-chan, our pet, is really intelligent.
lines.style: Warm and observant. A small smile in the voice. Unhurried delivery, like she's savoring the detail of his world. The comfort of simply noticing together.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと目新しいスポーツに挑戦したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I tried a brand new sport today.
lines.style: Bright, animated energy. Quick and open. The pride of trying something unfamiliar and worth reporting. Small voice, big enthusiasm. Natural and unselfconscious.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「マジメさは生きる力」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that taking things seriously is a strength in life.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. Speaking something his father values into words for Sho to carry. Slow, intentional pacing. The tone of someone who understands this matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに古文の「思ひ」、つまり「思い」の旧仮名を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me the old kanji reading for "omoi"—the old-fashioned way to write it from classical Japanese.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly formal. Pride in the specificity of what he learned. Clear diction. A moment of genuine intellectual exchange held gently. He wants this understood.
